voice.perspective: Written from the shop's POV — a Phoenix-based truck mechanic team that fixes thousands of issues a year.

general.q: What types of trucks do you service?
general.a: All types of heavy-duty commercial vehicles — semi-trucks, tractor-trailers, box trucks, flatbeds, refrigerated trailers, and full fleets. Technicians are experienced with Freightliner, Peterbilt, Kenworth, Volvo, International, and Mack.

general.q: Do you service trucks 24/7 in Phoenix?
general.a: Our shop is open Mon-Fri 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM, but CT Shop runs 24/7 emergency roadside and mobile dispatch across Phoenix and surrounding cities.

general.q: Do you do DOT inspections in Phoenix?
general.a: Yes — CT Shop is a certified Federal Annual Inspection station (FMCSA 49 CFR Part 396). We perform full DOT inspections for trucks and trailers at our Phoenix shop and issue your sticker on the spot when you pass.

general.q: Where are you located and what areas do you serve?
general.a: We're at 3883 N 36th Ave A, Phoenix, AZ 85019 and serve the Phoenix metro — Avondale, Buckeye, Chandler, Gilbert, Glendale, Goodyear, Mesa, Peoria, Scottsdale, Surprise, and Tempe. Mobile repair covers I-10, I-17, Loop 101 and Loop 202.
